verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable and local search is strong — scale spend before beef price pressure hits fall demand.
diagnosis: Instagram sales campaign returned $5.27 for every $1 spent this period, above the healthy 3-to-1 direct-to-consumer band.

signals.headline: 606 purchases on $3,969 spend
signals.detail: The Lamb Escalopes video drove strong sales volume this period at roughly $6.55 per purchase.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 5.27x
signals.detail: Every dollar spent on Instagram returned $5.27 in revenue this period. Well above the profitable threshold.

signals.headline: 415 add-to-carts, only 161 checkouts
signals.detail: Roughly 61% of shoppers who added to cart never started checkout. Friction between cart and checkout is bleeding revenue.

signals.headline: 13,347 followers, 178 new this period
signals.detail: Follower growth is modest for a brand pushing paid video. Organic content is not compounding audience quickly.

signals.headline: 273 reviews, latest at 5 stars
signals.detail: Google Business reputation is a real asset. Local search discovery is working for the Hoffman Estates butcher shop.

recommendations.title: Scale spend on the Lamb Escalopes video
recommendations.detail: At 5.27x return, consider raising daily budget 20–30% on the winning ad. Watch frequency (currently 1.32) to avoid audience fatigue as spend grows.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 39% of add-to-carts started checkout. Test a free shipping threshold, express checkout options, and an exit-intent offer to recover abandoned carts.

recommendations.title: Test farm-story creative alongside product videos
recommendations.detail: Sourcing transparency drives trust in this category. Worth testing a producer-story video against the current product-led ad to see if it lowers cost per purchase.
